EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Output Contract

Output Contract workflow for coding agents. Use when the user specifies an exact response format.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. Honor code-only, JSON-only, or other explicit constraints ahead of style defaults.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.

Populated example

Request: Return only a TypeScript code block.

Return the requested code block without an introduction or closer.

Use the helper

check_output_contract
